_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

WynnExcavation Site C#000.src: I need you to bring me something. It should be written in your content book.

WynnExcavation Site C#001.src: I can't let you through without a pass.

WynnExcavation Site C#002.src: Hello and welcome, senior members of Wynn Excavation Site C.

WynnExcavation Site C#003.src: May the dark's gaze forever watch over us. I want to update you on our progress thus far.

WynnExcavation Site C#004.src: The fire relic crystal has been largely intact in the heart of the volcano for many years.

WynnExcavation Site C#005.src: Removing it will most likely cause a chain reaction and make things difficult.

WynnExcavation Site C#006.src: Fortunately, a mage from the other side of the ocean is here to counter that.

WynnExcavation Site C#007.src: We can expect to have it moved and be shipped over to the undisclosed location any day now.

WynnExcavation Site C#008.src: I would also like to inform you that the crystals removed from our possession from sites B and A have not been retrieved.

WynnExcavation Site C#009.src: However, the culprit should no longer be interested in our operations.

WynnExcavation Site C#010.src: The lost crystals did not harness any raw magic, thus are not essential to the overall scheme.

WynnExcavation Site C#011.src: Now, our short term goals are to move our equipment out of the heart of the volcano and start moving the fire stone for assimilation at the concealed location.

WynnExcavation Site C#012.src: All senior officers are responsible for their quadrants. Let's get this done efficiently and discreetly.

WynnExcavation Site C#013.src: Everything you have been told is a lie. The WynnExcavation "company" is not what they appear to be.

WynnExcavation Site C#014.src: For the last few years, they have been seeking a quartet of cosmic crystals that have been prominent across Wynn's history.

WynnExcavation Site C#015.src: Many different empires and societies in the province have held at least one of them since they were uncovered {~} years ago deep within Wynn's southern border, though none have ever combined all four.

WynnExcavation Site C#016.src: The ancient desert empire, the Twain brothers, and an unknown party that cast this volcano's crystal into the ocean are among those who have guarded even one of these Crystals over the years. Their value is nothing short of immeasurable.

WynnExcavation Site C#017.src: WynnExcavation heard about it, and of course, set out to gather these artifacts in their attempt to claim absolute power over the entire world. Do you understand? We CANNOT let them have those crystals.

WynnExcavation Site C#018.src: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. If we wish to stop them, then it's an essential step.

similar.text: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. It is essential.

WynnExcavation Site C#019.src: I hope all of our troubles have been settled. Now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#019.dst: 우리 문제가 모두 해결되었기를 바라오. 그럼 실례하겠소, 참석할 회의가 있어서.

WynnExcavation Site C#020.src: Talk to Excavator Placardus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site B)
WynnExcavation Site C#020.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 발굴꾼 Placardus에게 말을 거세요 (Site B의 조각 필요)

WynnExcavation Site C#021.src: All operations functional... Transportation on schedule... Oh. It's you. We've been looking for you.
WynnExcavation Site C#021.dst: 모든 작업 정상... 운송 일정대로... 오. 당신이군요. 계속 찾고 있었습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#021.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#022.src: Locating you was far harder than we thought, but here you are, having come right to us.
WynnExcavation Site C#022.dst: 당신을 찾는 건 생각보다 훨씬 어려웠는데, 이렇게 제 발로 찾아오셨군요.
WynnExcavation Site C#022.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#023.src: Now you're here, I'm not sure what to say. But I feel I must explain, we at WynnExcavation apologise for all our previous encounters.
WynnExcavation Site C#023.dst: 막상 오시니 무슨 말을 해야 할지 모르겠군요. 그래도 설명은 해야겠죠. WynnExcavation은 지난 모든 충돌에 대해 사과드립니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#023.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#024.src: We completely got off on the wrong foot. We are a company from Gavel which specialises in historic artifacts of great mystical importance.
WynnExcavation Site C#024.dst: 우리는 처음부터 완전히 어긋났습니다. 우리는 신비적으로 중요한 역사 유물을 전문으로 다루는 Gavel의 회사입니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#024.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#025.src: After our encounter in {p}, we naturally thought you were a black market salesperson trying to steal pieces of the artifact for monetary gain.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.dst: {p}에서 마주친 뒤로, 우리는 당연히 당신을 돈을 노리고 유물 조각을 훔치는 암시장 상인이라 여겼습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#026.src: So we instructed all of our employees in all of our sites to thwart you at any cost. Historical loss is a very important issue, especially with something so powerful.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.dst: 그래서 모든 현장의 직원에게 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 당신을 막으라고 지시했죠. 역사적 손실은 매우 중대한 문제입니다, 그토록 강력한 물건이라면 더욱요.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#027.src: But after hearing the stories of your travels in the province, we realised what had happened, and you mistook us for the enemy. This is obviously not the case.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.dst: 하지만 지방을 누비는 당신의 여행담을 듣고서야 무슨 일이 있었는지 알았습니다. 당신은 우리를 적으로 오해했죠. 물론 그렇지 않습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#028.src: I hope this clears everything up between us and we can both move our separate ways, now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.dst: 이걸로 우리 사이의 오해가 풀리고 각자의 길을 갈 수 있기를 바랍니다. 그럼 실례하죠, 참석할 회의가 있어서요.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#029.src: Infiltrate the Excavation Meeting. The meeting is held in a diamond-pickaxe room, the portal being located to the left of the entrance to a large lava cave.
WynnExcavation Site C#029.dst: 발굴 회의에 잠입하세요. 회의는 다이아몬드 곡괭이가 있는 방에서 열리며, 포털은 거대한 용암 동굴 입구 왼쪽에 있습니다.

WynnExcavation Site C#030.src: I'm sorry. This is a private meeting.
WynnExcavation Site C#030.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#031.src: It is only my first day on the job, so I can't let you in without a pass. Sorry.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.dst: 오늘 첫 근무라서요, 통행증 없이는 들여보낼 수 없습니다. 죄송합니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#032.src: The door will be locked shortly.
WynnExcavation Site C#032.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#034.src: Hello and welcome, senior members of Wynn Excavation Site C. May the dark's gaze forever watch over us. I want to update you on our progress thus far. The fire relic crystal has been largely intact in the heart of the volcano for many years.
WynnExcavation Site C#034.dst: 환영합니다, Wynn Excavation C 현장의 고위 구성원 여러분. 어둠의 시선이 영원히 우리를 굽어보기를. 지금까지의 진척을 보고드리겠습니다. 불의 유물 수정은 오랜 세월 화산 심장부에서 거의 온전하게 남아 있었습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#034.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#035.src: Removing it will most likely cause a chain reaction and make things difficult. Fortunately, a mage from the other side of the ocean is here to counter that. We can expect to have it moved and be shipped over to the undisclosed location any day now.
WynnExcavation Site C#035.dst: 그것을 꺼내면 연쇄 반응이 일어나 일이 까다로워질 가능성이 큽니다. 다행히 바다 건너에서 온 마법사가 이를 막아 줄 겁니다. 머지않아 수정을 옮겨 비공개 장소로 운송할 수 있으리라 봅니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#035.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#036.src: I would also like to inform you that the crystals removed from our possession from sites B and A have not been retrieved. However, the culprit should no longer be interested in our operations. The lost crystals did not harness any raw magic, thus are not essential to the overall scheme.
WynnExcavation Site C#036.dst: 또한 B 현장과 A 현장에서 우리 손을 떠난 수정들은 아직 회수하지 못했음을 알려 드립니다. 다만 범인은 더 이상 우리 작전에 관심이 없을 겁니다. 잃어버린 수정들은 원시 마력을 품지 않아 전체 계획에 필수적이지 않습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#036.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#037.src: Now, our short term goals are to move our equipment out of the heart of the volcano and start moving the fire stone for assimilation at the concealed location. All senior officers are responsible for their quadrants. Let's get this done efficiently and discreetly.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.dst: 이제 단기 목표는 화산 심장부에서 장비를 빼내고, 은닉 장소에서의 동화를 위해 불의 돌을 옮기기 시작하는 것입니다. 모든 고위 간부는 각자의 구역을 책임집니다. 효율적이고 은밀하게 처리합시다.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#039.src: The alarm has been set off! There is an unauthorized guest! Guards, seize them!
WynnExcavation Site C#039.dst: 경보가 울렸다! 허가받지 않은 손님이 있다! 경비, 잡아라!
WynnExcavation Site C#039.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#041.src: Explore the area and search for the traitor

WynnExcavation Site C#042.src: You. You are the one they are worried about.
WynnExcavation Site C#042.dst: 당신. 저들이 걱정하는 게 바로 당신이군.

WynnExcavation Site C#043.src: I am Amadel, leader of the rebellion.

WynnExcavation Site C#044.src: I know this is all a bit sudden, but I have some information you must hear.
WynnExcavation Site C#044.dst: 갑작스러운 건 알지만, 당신이 들어야 할 정보가 있소.
WynnExcavation Site C#044.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#045.src: Everything you have been told is a lie. The Wynn Excavation “company” are not what they appear to be.
WynnExcavation Site C#045.dst: 당신이 들은 모든 건 거짓이오. Wynn Excavation이라는 "회사"는 겉보기와 다르오.
WynnExcavation Site C#045.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#046.src: They are using that as a front and their reach stretches further than I even know.
WynnExcavation Site C#046.dst: 그건 위장일 뿐이고, 그들의 손길은 나도 모를 만큼 멀리 뻗어 있소.
WynnExcavation Site C#046.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#047.src: There is no higher authority than them, not even the kings. And their intentions are not good.
WynnExcavation Site C#047.dst: 그들 위에 있는 권력은 없소, 왕들조차도. 그리고 그들의 의도는 선하지 않소.
WynnExcavation Site C#047.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#048.src: They seek the ultimate power, a power hidden across Wynn by various civilizations over hundreds of years.
WynnExcavation Site C#048.dst: 그들은 궁극의 힘을 노리오. 수백 년에 걸쳐 여러 문명이 Wynn 곳곳에 숨긴 힘을.
WynnExcavation Site C#048.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#049.src: They heard about it, and of course, began to gather the ingredients to create something that would lead them to total domination of the province.
WynnExcavation Site C#049.dst: 그 소문을 듣고는 당연히, 지방을 완전히 지배하게 해 줄 무언가를 만들 재료를 모으기 시작했소.
WynnExcavation Site C#049.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#050.src: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. It is essential.
WynnExcavation Site C#050.dst: 그들은 한동안 나를 주시해 왔소. 여기서 전부 말할 순 없지만, 우선 지난번처럼 수정 조각을 모아야 하오. 반드시 필요한 일이오.
WynnExcavation Site C#050.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#051.src: The crystal is in the cave just inside the volcano past the base. Hurry, they are all off duty at the moment, the cave to the heart of the volcano is clear. Act swiftly, and good luck.
WynnExcavation Site C#051.dst: 수정은 기지를 지나 화산 안쪽 동굴에 있소. 서두르시오, 지금은 모두 근무를 쉬고 있어 화산 심장부로 가는 동굴이 비었소. 신속히 움직이길, 행운을 비오.
WynnExcavation Site C#051.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#052.src: Explore the depths of the volcano

WynnExcavation Site C#053.src: Escape the volcano with the crystal shard

WynnExcavation Site C#054.src: Report back to Excavator Placardus with a [Red Crystal Shard]
WynnExcavation Site C#054.dst: [Red Crystal Shard]를 들고 발굴꾼 Placardus에게 보고하세요

WynnExcavation Site C#055.src: You couldn't just take my polite word and leave it at that, could you?
WynnExcavation Site C#055.dst: 제 정중한 말을 그대로 받아들이고 물러설 수는 없었나 보군요?
WynnExcavation Site C#055.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#056.src: You had to go snooping around, meddle in things that are far beyond your comprehension. No matter. Something did come out of this, it would appear.
WynnExcavation Site C#056.dst: 굳이 여기저기 기웃거리며 당신의 이해를 한참 넘어선 일에 끼어들었죠. 상관없습니다. 덕분에 얻은 것도 있는 듯하니까요.
WynnExcavation Site C#056.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#057.src: You were caught, conversing with Amadel, who we now know to be a traitor, thanks to you. There are eyes everywhere, young hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#057.dst: 당신은 Amadel과 대화하다 발각됐습니다. 덕분에 그가 배신자라는 것도 알게 됐죠. 눈은 어디에나 있습니다, 젊은 영웅이여.
WynnExcavation Site C#057.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#058.src: I'm willing to bet he's already been... taken care of by senior staff.
WynnExcavation Site C#058.dst: 장담하건대 그는 이미... 고위 직원들에게 처리됐을 겁니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#058.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#059.src: We also now know you are operating in the dark. You know nothing of the crystals or their power, and you know not that even the crystals you possess are inconsequential to our plans.
WynnExcavation Site C#059.dst: 또한 당신이 아무것도 모른 채 움직인다는 것도 알게 됐습니다. 수정도, 그 힘도 전혀 모르고, 손에 넣은 수정조차 우리 계획엔 하찮다는 것도 모르죠.
WynnExcavation Site C#059.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#060.src: You're lucky you aren't dead. How you infiltrated us this far has shown nothing but beginner's luck for the province's new hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#060.dst: 죽지 않은 게 다행입니다. 여기까지 잠입한 것도 이 지방의 새 영웅이 누린 초심자의 행운일 뿐이죠.
WynnExcavation Site C#060.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#061.src: I suggest you leave, before the guards get here and you meet the same fate as Amadel. Our power is limitless; armies, resources, even royalty are on our side. Our gaze is everpresent. Now, get out of my sight!
WynnExcavation Site C#061.dst: 경비들이 오기 전에, Amadel과 같은 운명을 맞기 전에 떠나시길 권합니다. 우리의 힘엔 한계가 없습니다. 군대, 자원, 심지어 왕족까지 우리 편이죠. 우리의 시선은 어디에나 있습니다. 자, 내 눈앞에서 사라지시죠!
WynnExcavation Site C#061.speaker: Excavator Placardus
